_schema.PROCESS_NAME: string (required) - seeded process with subprocesses; read only
_schema.SUBPROCESS_NAME: string (required) - level-1 subprocess of PROCESS_NAME used for the PSR KPI and children samplers
_schema.ENTITY_TYPES: string[] (required) - entity types whose template limits are read
_schema.PAGE_SIZES: number[] (required) - PSR page sizes for the subprocess children
_schema.DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE: number (required) - page size the subprocess children route uses when pageSize is omitted or not positive
_schema.UNKNOWN_PROCESS_NAME: string (required) - process name that does not exist
_schema.UNKNOWN_ENTITY_TYPE: string (required) - entity type that has no template limits
_schema.RBAC_DENIED_ERROR_CODE: string (required) - errorCode when the RBAC check rejects a process name
_schema.LIAM_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND_ERROR_CODE: string (required) - errorCode of /users when LIAM has no resource for the process
_schema.PROCESS_NOT_FOUND_ERROR_CODE: string (required) - errorCode for an unknown process on routes without RBAC
_schema.ENTITY_NOT_FOUND_ERROR_CODE: string (required) - errorCode for an unknown entity type
